references.text: Refers to the same geographical location 'in the valley opposite Beth-peor' where the people of Israel camped
Moses was buried in the valley in the land of Moab, opposite Beth-peor - the same place mentioned here
Describes the battle against Sihon, king of the Amorites who lived in Heshbon, whom Moses and the Israelites defeated
Parallel account of the victory over Sihon, king of the Amorites who lived in Heshbon
Refers to the same event where Sihon, king of Heshbon, was defeated by Israel
Mentions Sihon, king of the Amorites who lived in Heshbon, and his territory
Beth-peor was associated with Baal-peor, the place of Israel's sin with Moabite women
Describes Sihon's kingdom and his cities, including Heshbon, which were given to the tribe of Reuben
